message: The other night, we had a surprise blackout, and for once, I wasn’t scrambling around in the dark like a headless chicken. I had a couple of flashlights ready, a power bank charged up for my phone, and even a little lantern to keep things cozy. It felt great to finally be the prepared one while everyone else was looking for matches to light candles. Who knew being ready could feel this good? Have you ever found yourself surprisingly prepared?
